tool_args.rationale: The short-horizon rows are positive and the acquired H=7.66, 15.77, and 21.9 rows establish the predicted reversal. Fit the four positive dual-horizon parameters numerically to all eight observations. The module-level fitted parameters let predict(row) use the fit without requiring row mutation or a nonstandard argument.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Already acquired; three additional horizon measurements span the target range and directly reveal reversal.
The observed horizon-dependent sign reversal is explained by the authorized four-parameter dual-exponential model; the added data would not resolve a material remaining ambiguity.
Irrelevant high-variance auxiliary measurement; it does not identify the target law.
